findings.title: PatchAll shares the StatPart injector's static constructor, so one failed patch silently drops every entad stat effect
findings.detail: EntadStatPartInjector calls new Harmony(...).PatchAll() before adding StatPart_Entad to the stats. Five targets are chosen at runtime (Patch_FuelConsumptionRate, Patch_FuelCapacity, Patch_HeatOutput, Patch_PowerGeneration, Patch_TemperatureControlPower) and only a launch can confirm they bind. If any one throws, StaticConstructorOnStartupUtility.CallAll logs one error and moves on, the injection loop never runs, and every trait's stat offsets, factors and market value disappear with no further error. Move the PatchAll call into the existing EntadMod constructor (Source/EntadSettings.cs:75), or anywhere outside this static constructor, so the stat injection doesn't depend on every patch binding.

findings.title: ExplanationPart ignores offsetsViaWearer, so gear can explain an offset TransformValue did not apply
findings.detail: TransformValue skips statOffsets for wearer stats on apparel and equipment, but ExplanationPart still lists every revealed offset. StatWorker.ShouldShowFor hides Pawn* categories on non-pawns, so this only shows for Meditation or EquippedStatOffsets-category stats displayed on gear itself. Computing the same offsetsViaWearer flag in ExplanationPart and gating the offsets loop on it would keep the number and its explanation in agreement.

findings.title: MarketValue entries in a trait's statOffsets/statFactors are applied but never explained
findings.detail: TransformValue applies statOffsets and statFactors for parentStat == MarketValue as well as MarketValueOffset(), but ExplanationPart's MarketValue branch 'continue's past them. This mod's Defs never list MarketValue, but other mods can add EntadTraitDefs that do.
